note: HSJ2 record-frame cross-vector (ADR-0056). CRC = sha256(len_le32 ++ seq_le64 ++ kind_u8 ++ payload)[0..4], crc field = literal 4 frame bytes (little-endian). Bytes generated by the Python reference formula; Rust walk() and Python accept.parse_journal() must both accept them and agree on kind+crc. kind_flip is the frozen negative control: flipping kind without recomputing CRC MUST be rejected by both.
